title: Ashtine Olviga, David Licauco say they are not competing with other love teams
summary: David Licauco and Ashtine Olviga are not treating other popular love teams as competitors as they prepare for the premiere of their first lead series together, the Filipino adaptation of the hit…

blocks.text: David Licauco and Ashtine Olviga are not treating other popular love teams as competitors as they prepare for the premiere of their first lead series together, the Filipino adaptation of the hit Korean drama “Fight for My Way.” The two actors, who previously worked with different screen partners, said they are happy with the success of their fellow artists and believe everyone has their own path in the entertainment industry.
